description: Legacy PostgreSQL RLS using current_setting('app.performance_tenant_id') is not proof of tenant identity when a SQL login can freely set its session GUC.
remediation_requirements: Do not grant SQL client access or use direct SQL roles controlled by external callers
Review legacy role grants and remove or replace GUC-based direct-table access before production
Bind tenant to independently authenticated Portal/IAM identity in trusted service
Independent PostgreSQL RLS and SECURITY DEFINER ownership/grant review by AppSec and DBA
Test credential rotation, pooling, revocation, and tenant move/reassignment
